blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: de belangrijkste stijlfiguren in het Engels herkennen en gebruiken
ironie en understatement begrijpen, typisch voor Brits Engels
retorische middelen inzetten in een toespraak of betoog

head: Stijlfiguur
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: She sings like an angel. He's as cold as ice.
I've told you a million times.
Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
Who doesn't want to be happy?

blocks.text: Britse sprekers zeggen vaak minder dan ze bedoelen, of het tegenovergestelde. Herken de toon:

head: Wat er gezegd wordt
Wat er bedoeld wordt
rows: It was a bit of a disaster.

blocks.title: Litotes: not bad = goed
blocks.text: Een litotes zegt iets positiefs door het tegendeel te ontkennen: not bad (goed), not uncommon (vrij gewoon), not without risk (riskant). Het Nederlands kent dit ook (niet slecht), maar Britten gebruiken het veel vaker.

head: Middel
Voorbeeld
Effect
rows: We will fight for freedom, for justice and for equality.
We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds ...
Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
You might ask yourself why this matters.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: "She sings like an angel" is a ______.
items.full: "She sings like an angel" is a simile.

items.q: "I've told you a million times" is an example of ______.
items.full: "I've told you a million times" is an example of hyperbole.
My grandfather passed away last year.

items.q: The company had to let fifty people ______.
items.full: The company had to let fifty people go.

items.q: The film wasn't ______ at all. I really enjoyed it.
items.full: The film wasn't bad at all. I really enjoyed it.

items.q: He was rather economical with the ______.
items.full: He was rather economical with the truth.

items.q: There was a deafening ______ after the announcement.
items.full: There was a deafening silence after the announcement.

items.q: ______, there are risks. But the benefits are greater.
items.full: Admittedly, there are risks. But the benefits are greater.

items.q: Het was niet slecht. (litotes, betekent: goed)
Ik heb het je al duizend keer gezegd.
items.a: I've told you a thousand times.
